artists.biography: Noveller is the solo project of Brooklyn-based sound artist and filmmaker Sarah Lipstate. She has performed in Rhys Chatham’s Guitar Army, and as a member of Glenn Branca’s 100 guitar ensemble. In March 2008, Lipstate joined Brooklyn art-rock outfit Parts & Labor as their guitarist. She contributed to the band's critically-acclaimed release Receivers and completed several U.S. and European tours before leaving the band in July 2009. Last year, Lipstate performed as part of the Underground at the Abrons performance series at the Abrons Arts Center on the Lower East Side of Manhattan. In December, she played at the Un Son Par Là, Music of Today festival in Nîmes, France. She recently performed in the revival of Rhys Chatham and Karole Armitage's "Drastic-Classicism" as part of the Think Punk! program at The Kitchen in NYC. Following that performance, she joined Rhys Chatham and his cast of guitar-allstars at the Metropolitan Museum of Art for a performance of his minimalist punk classic "Guitar Trio". Along with 199 other guitar players, Lipstate performed in Chatham's "A Crimson Grail" for 200 guitars which debuted at Lincoln Center's Damrosch Park in August 2009. In April, No Fun Productions released her debut LP Paint on the Shadows. Following the release, Lipstate performed at No Fun Fest at the Music Hall of Williamsburg in Brooklyn. In September, the label released her full-length CD follow-up titled Red Rainbows and Lipstate performed at No Fun Fest Sweden in Stockholm. Noveller recently accompanied St. Vincent from 2013-2014 in over two dozen dates of St. Vincent's Digital Witness tour. Her short films screened at the SXSW film festival in both 2006 and 2007, and earned Lipstate the "Diamond in the Rough Cut" award for exceptional emerging filmmaker at Cinematexas 2006. Her short, Memory Scars, screened at the Reel Venus Film Festival at Anthology Film Archives in NYC in October 2008. She debuted a new short film, Interior Variations, at the New Museum in NYC as part of No Fun: Infinite Sound and Image in May. She has previously performed as a member of Cold Cave, Parts & Labor, One Umbrella and Sands. Lipstate received a BS in Radio-Television-Film at the University of Texas at Austin in December 2006, and currently resides in the Bushwick neighborhood of Brooklyn, NY, USA. www.sarahlipstate.com www.myspace.com/noveller Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
A Pink Sunset For No One is the eighth studio album by Noveller, the solo project of guitarist and composer Sarah Lipstate, released on February 10, 2017, via Fire Records. The album is rooted in electronic and drone music, showcasing Lipstate’s mastery of the electric guitar as she crafts expansive, atmospheric soundscapes. Using layered textures, looping, and effects, Lipstate creates immersive compositions that blur the line between ambient and experimental electronic music, often evoking a sense of both melancholy and wonder.

Musically, A Pink Sunset For No One stands as a refined example of Lipstate’s signature style, where minimal melodic elements are stretched into rich, evolving sonic environments. The album’s tracks, including “Deep Shelter” and the title track, highlight her ability to generate emotional depth and complexity from a single instrument. As her eighth release, it further solidified Noveller’s reputation as a leading voice in contemporary experimental guitar music, building on the strengths of her earlier work while pushing her sound into new, more nuanced territory.

The album received positive critical attention for its atmospheric depth and technical ingenuity, with outlets such as Drowned in Sound and BBC 6 Music highlighting its emotional resonance and innovative approach. While not a commercial blockbuster, A Pink Sunset For No One was recognized as a standout entry in Noveller’s discography and a significant contribution to the electronic and drone genres in 2017.
